summary: Xylem Inc. filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a public offering of senior notes and senior blue notes. The filing details the terms, including aggregate principal amounts, interest rates, maturities, optional redemption, and change-of-control repurchase at 101%. Notes are unsecured and rank equally with other unsubordinated debt. Proceeds from blue notes will fund eligible blue projects. There are no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring.
